subject: Welding and Fabrication Engineering Craft Practice

subStrands.name: Safety, Codes, Layout and First Aid

objectives.description: Introduction to fabrication and welding practice; safety precautions — types and causes of accident (fire, explosion, sharp objects, hazardous gases), accident prevention measures, types and causes of environmental pollution, methods of preventing environmental pollution, safety facilities and protective wears.
Workshop layout (fabrication and welding); standard welding codes and symbols; first-aid administration in the workshop.

subStrands.name: Ferrous/Non-Ferrous Metals, Sheet Metal and Heat Treatment

objectives.description: Ferrous and non-ferrous metals: steel, aluminium, cast iron, copper and zinc, tin, alloy steel.
Properties of metals: ductility, hardness, toughness, malleability, fusion and tenacity, brittleness, elasticity and plasticity.
Sheet metal (aluminium, mild steel, brass): concept of sheet metal; gauges of sheet metal; selection of suitable metals for specific jobs.
Heat treatment of metals: hardening, annealing, normalising, tempering and case-hardening.

subStrands.name: Fabrication and Welding Tools, Equipment and Maintenance

objectives.description: Identification of tools and equipment for fabrication and welding; equipment set-up for gas, arc welding and fabrication; job holding devices; measuring instruments, marking out and cutting tools.
Identification of parts and accessories for gas and arc welding; maintenance procedure for arc and gas (oxy-acetylene) welding equipment; preparation of acetylene gas from carbide.
Types of electrodes and their composition, application, gauges, selection for specific jobs; equipment for fault detection and trouble shooting.

subStrands.name: Welding Types, Joints, Marking Out, Templates and Fabrication Techniques

objectives.description: Types of welding (gas and arc): explanation of the principles of gas and arc welding and their differences; description of a typical fabrication process.

Types of joints, joint methods and application in welding and fabrication; classification of marking out techniques; description of the use of templates for fabricated and welded assemblies; welding techniques and application.
Techniques in fabrication work: description of folding techniques and their importance in fabrication work.

subStrands.name: Permanent and Temporary Fasteners, Rivets, Bolts, Screws and Forging

objectives.description: Classification of fasteners; permanent fasteners — rivet and its application (types, uses); temporary fasteners — bolt and nuts (description, uses); classes of rivets and screws.
Forging process: definition; forging tools and equipment (furnace, swages, fullers, flatters and tongs); forging processes — upsetting, drawing down, bending, twisting.
